source_feature.method: Converted all WGS84 ring vertices through project transform; retained full polygon and centered local geometry at its bounds center
source_feature.area_discrepancy_note: GIS Shape__Area reports 8918.01 while the project local transform ring area is 5158.85 m2; metric agreement not assumed pending review of source area units/projection.

area_reconciliation.result: Resolved projection difference; the footprint identity is consistent across the two cached Purdue GIS snapshots.
area_reconciliation.feature_match: Both snapshots contain one FID 273 / PHYS polygon with the same single 34-vertex EPSG:4326 ring; every coordinate matches.
area_reconciliation.calculation: Project local ring shoelace area is 5158.8513 m². Purdue Shape__Area is 8918.0078 m² in the underlying Web Mercator service plane. At centroid latitude 40.4300°, 8918.0078*cos(latitude)^2 = 5167.30 m², within 0.17% of the locally transformed ring. This is the expected Web Mercator area scale distortion (sec(latitude)^2), plus small projection / rounding differences; it is not a second footprint or omitted ring.
area_reconciliation.source_crs_detail: Service-native EPSG:3857/102100 Shape__Area is planar Web Mercator area; API response coordinates were requested in EPSG:4326. Project local coordinates use the project equirectangular approximation.
area_reconciliation.geometry_review: GIS source has one exterior ring and no additional hole/disjoint rings. Shape is unchanged in this revision.

height_evidence.interpretation: F01/F02/F03 and R suggest 3 principal stories to roof datum 52.25 ft = 15.92m. GIS NUM_LEVELS=8 and Extrution=84 conflict with visible three-story envelope; those fields are retained but not used as measured elevation. Wall height and roof shape are estimates informed by photos.

geometry_edits: Created independent detailed library from FID 273 footprint; retained local project coordinate frame.
Extruded exact GIS outline to estimated 12.20 m main wall line; modeled approximately 3 visible stories.
Added estimated hipped red tile roof to 15.92 m roof datum based on GIS R field and Purdue photographs.
Added repeated window/sill/stone trim rhythm based on photos; opening count, dimensions and individual elevations are estimates.
Added a schematic central stone entry and large arched upper window as shown in official imagery; exact entrance side and dimensions remain estimated.
Did not model interior, since no floor-plan evidence was verified.
Did not model exterior skybridge because the cited photo shows a connection but its endpoint, dimensions and relation to the GIS footprint could not be independently verified.

validation.uncertainty: Footprint and origin are GIS-derived; area is inconsistent with service Shape__Area, height/facade details estimated; entrance frontage selection unverified. Google Street View not directly inspected.
validation.reopen_check: Saved, reopened from the saved .blend in Blender 5.2.3, and rerendered from that reopened scene; stable collection, placement_origin_xy_m, geometry, materials and source-file hash checked.

notes: Compared the same FID 273 one-ring, 34-vertex footprint in two Purdue GIS snapshots and documented the Web Mercator/project-frame area reconciliation.
Rebuilt the central portal, prominent PHYSICS sign, arched upper window and fanlight divisions; relocated/rebuilt the source skybridge to align its ends with the nearest PHYS/MSEE GIS wall points.
Saved the calculated MSEE-aligned source-local/master-coordinate endpoint transform in the evidence report; master placements are unchanged and span/height remain estimated.

Added a warm schematic vestibule cue behind the glazed entry, plus a short entry walk and paired low planters. Interior room layout, site furniture, and planting placement are interpretive, not survey-derived.
